This Kotlin Multiplatform repo targets native D-Bus support.

Layout: `src/commonMain/kotlin` shared API/serialization; `src/nativeMain/kotlin` + `src/nativeInterop/cinterop` Linux native impl/C interop; `src/nativeTest/kotlin/{unit,integration,mocks}` native tests/fixtures; `codegen/` JVM CLI/library for XML-to-Kotlin generation; `plugin/` Gradle plugin (`com.monkopedia.sdbus.plugin`) on `:codegen`; `compile_test/` compile-time integration; `samples/bluez-scan/` example.

Use repo-root Gradle wrapper:
`./gradlew build`
`./gradlew test`
`./gradlew ktlintCheck`
`./gradlew licenseCheck`
`./gradl
